description: This file provides extension methods for the ISiloBuilder interface to configure Redis as the grain storage provider in an Orleans application. It includes methods to add Redis storage with optional configuration actions, and distinguishes between default and named storage configurations.

classes.name: RedisSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to configure Redis as a grain storage provider.

methods.name: AddRedisGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures Redis as the default grain storage provider with optional configuration.

methods.name: AddRedisGrainStorage
methods.description: Configures Redis as a named grain storage provider with specified options.

methods.name: AddRedisGrainStorageAsDefault (overload)
methods.description: Configures Redis as the default grain storage provider without explicit configuration (null passed).

methods.name: AddRedisGrainStorage (overload)
methods.description: Configures Redis as a named grain storage provider with optional configuration options builder.
